android.desc:
Command Stick™ is a floating widget operated by dragging through its four sections. 
Fluid, patented, gesture-based controls significantly improve on Android’s standard UI by removing the need to reach for the notification shade, creating a far more ergonomic and flexible experience. 

With the free version users can perform a variety of functions from the same small footprint, quickly summon CS to any location and fire off effortless commands from muscle memory. CS offers greater speed, efficiency and functionality by enabling seamless access to media controls, navigation flows and more. We have even enabled new functionality such as song skip previews – something currently unavailable through standard Android.

The paid version offers even more functionality and theme customisation, including the revolutionary command chaining system.
Customise Command Stick™ to make it your own with custom commands and themes set through the app. 

Feature list:
• custom commands
• custom themes
• integrated dial
• badge mode
• resizable
• quick start mode
• variable opacity
• auto docking
• available on lock screen
• limitlessly chain commands together with a single touch*
• fluid animations

Command list:
• media actions dial (play/pause, open media, like, shuffle mode, repeat mode, share, playback speed)
• volume
• scrub media
• skip media
• change media source
• scroll
• favourite apps
• app switcher
• zoom
• torch (dimmable)
• brightness
• device actions (auto rotate, auto brightness, ringer, wifi, nfc) 
• browser tab switcher
• browser history


Theme list:
• media
• media pixelated*
• media blurred*
• standard dark
• standard light
• tennis ball*
• candy*
• Rams classic*
• Rams metallic*
• GPT*
• Gerstner metachrome blue*
• Gerstner constructive*
• atom*
• gruvbox*


Command Stick™ is work of two people - please consider supporting our tiny team by purchasing premium. CS is updated biweekly with new commands, themes and advanced functionality.

Command Stick™ uses the accessibility API to:
• detect the current app in use
• control the media being played
• display a floating widget

* Functionality only available to premium plan subscribers.

quotes.text:
Hi community, developer of Command Stick here. 
We just released our first monthly update to our Android app. Would love for you to try it out and give us feedback.

Command Stick is a super app that allows you to control anything and everything with a one touch. Switch tabs, navigate your favourite apps, scrub media forward/backwards, skip media with song name previews, change media source, app switch and more.

Here's a video: https://youtu.be/T-2mUKd6jsI?si=x6f5qrO_ylKH28co

June Monthly Update:
* Quick Start & Dismissal functionality added
* Browser tab switching dial
* New Media themes (blurred, pixelated)
* New Designer theme Gerstner (metachrome blue, constructive)

Features:
* Custom commands
* Custom themes
* Haptic feedback
* No input speed limit
* Fully flexible and resizable

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.commmandstick.core
